source: OpenAlex API /works (IDs written from the response by scripts/run_search.py)
query: "informal sector" AND urban AND (workers OR livelihoods OR employment)
filter: title_and_abstract.search.exact:"informal sector" AND urban AND (workers OR livelihoods OR employment),is_retracted:false,publication_year:2022-2026
oql:
get works where retracted is (false)
  and year >= (2022)
  and year <= (2026)
  and title-abstract has ("informal sector" AND "urban" AND ("employment" OR "livelihoods" OR "workers"))
